XDOCUMENTO.Titolo: System reset after disconnecting the battery

XCAPITOLO.Corpo: The battery is located in the engine compartment, on the driver's side, near the wheel arch.

If the battery needs to be disconnected, it is necessary to:

  • Check that all electrical devices in the car, such as the car radio, sat nav, etc., are switched off
  • Check that the ignition is switched off
  • Have the radio code to hand
  • Switch off the ignition and wait 5 minutes

    You can then disconnect the battery, removing the negative terminal first and then the positive terminal

    After disconnecting the battery, wait a few minutes before working on the airbag system

To reconnect the battery, proceed as follows:

  • First connect the positive terminal and then the negative terminal of the battery
  • Reset the radio code (if necessary)
  • Clear any errors in the memory
  • Turn on the ignition and wait 40 seconds
  • Turn off the ignition

Electric roof initialisation procedure:

  • Turn on the ignition
  • Press and hold the roof closure button
  • Wait for the electric roof to close completely
  • After the roof is completely closed, wait for the electric motor to stop
  • Release the electric roof close button

    The system is now initialised.

After disconnecting the battery, "Radio Code" may appear on the car radio monitor, followed by " - - - -"
You must then enter the radio code.
Use the preset radio station buttons (1 to 6).
If the 4 digits are not entered within 20 seconds, the message "Enter Code - - - -" will appear on the display.
After entering the 4 digits, it may take up to 20 seconds before the car radio starts working.
